Led end-to-end operational risk assessment and control testing programs as part of the
second line of defence (2LOD), applying structured frameworks to evaluate internal
controls, policies, and practices, ensuring continuous alignment with Group standards,
regulatory requirements, and enterprise risk appetite across the organisation.
Coordinated and performed Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSA), maintained the
risk register, and executed root cause and impact analyses for identified control
deficiencies; monitored action plans and conducted regular follow-up with business
owners, driving measurable improvement in control maturity and achieving sustainable
issue closure across critical risk functions.
Identified, analysed, and reported operational losses and incidents through dedicated
governance tools, maintaining key risk indicator (KRI) reporting and preparing risk
reports and management information for governance committees and boards, enabling
faster, data-driven decision-making by senior stakeholders.
Took ownership of developing, updating, and maintaining risk policies, functional
concepts, and procedural instructions, including AML and financial crime regulatory
requirements, ensuring alignment with Group rules and evolving regulatory standards.
Identified a gap in post-disposition follow-through on third-party findings and
implemented validation cycles to track corrective actions through to resolution,
directly strengthening the control environment, reducing residual risk, and improving
overall risk management maturity.
Managed enterprise-wide RCSA programs, scoping and assessing inherent and residual
risks across operational areas, mapping findings to key and non-key controls in the Risk
Control Matrix, and maintaining consistent audit readiness.
Led walkthroughs to evaluate control design effectiveness, identify critical gaps, and
establish test objectives and documentation standards directing end-to-end design and
operational effectiveness testing using statistical sampling methods to identify control
weaknesses requiring remediation.
Partnered with business control owners to develop detailed remediation plans, define
accountability, and monitor progress through governance dashboards  presenting
findings and actionable insights in risk committee forums to support informed decision-
making by senior management.
Reviewed and approved test documentation and workpapers ensuring adherence to
global audit methodologies and internal quality standards maintaining high-quality
control assurance delivery across all risk functions.
Identified a critical manual control vulnerability, built the case for automation, and
collaborated with the technical team to implement the solution delivering 2 FTE
savings, eliminating human error risk, and directly contributing to a stronger financial
risk control environment across the organisation.
Risk and Controls professional with over 10 years of experience in banking and financial services,
specialising in operational risk management, RCSA, internal controls, and regulatory compliance.
Proven track record of identifying and reporting operational losses and incidents, driving
remediation cycles, and preparing risk reports and management information that support confident,
data-driven governance decisions by senior stakeholders and committees. Eager to contribute a
structured, process-driven approach to operational risk framework development within a dynamic,
international banking environment.
